description: Replace a belief with an updated one. The old fact is closed and linked to its successor — history is preserved, never deleted. Use when the user corrects you or circumstances change. Find the old fact's id with recall first. valid_from can backdate when the new state actually began (e.g. 'moved last month'). importance and kind are inherited from the old fact unless you override them.

basis.description: How you know the correction. Sets confidence. Default user-stated

importance.description: 1–10 salience override; default inherits the old fact's importance

kind.description: Override the memory kind; default inherits the old fact's kind

old_fact_id.description: Id of the fact being superseded

source_commit.description: Git SHA you re-read this code at; re-pins the corrected fact. Not inherited from the old fact — supply it if the correction came from code.

source_path.description: Repo-relative file path the corrected fact describes, if any.

valid_from.description: ISO 8601: when the new state became true, if not now

name: revise
